caveats: Proposal only: no completed evidence-run manifest and no canonical writes. MAIN owns shared v2 method registration and acceptance.

Five selected originals reviewed; 310 other material rows remain interpreted-only. All 315 rows retain exact source locators. No geography, identity, date, license or taxon contradiction was found in the retained NJ material.

Seven interpreted records lack individualCount, including both selected Bergen originals. Explicit PRESENT and HUMAN_OBSERVATION support occurrence without a numeric count; missing count is not a negative or captive observation.

CONTINENT_DERIVED_FROM_COORDINATES is a continent annotation; county authority remains the exact publisher county. TAXON_CONCEPT_ID_NOT_FOUND leaves the Avibase concept unresolved while exact accepted GBIF species classifications agree.
Missing uncertainty and photographs do not alone invalidate an explicit original county. These are historical point observations, not countywide abundance or current persistence statements.

Home, apartment, yard, garden, colony, nest and stables/refuge locality words do not themselves establish captivity, breeding success or population establishment. No specific captive contradiction was found in the five originals or 315 retained interpreted rows.
eBird rules favor wild observations, but dataset context is not individual proof of wildness or expert human approval. Opaque not_reviewed and crawler fields retain qualified dataset context.
The two Hudson selected records share an observer on consecutive dates; records do not establish independent sampling or a combined abundance total.
Essex has only one retained candidate and original. Partial parent pagination does not establish the absence of additional Essex records.
No fresh retrieval, source-screen completion, establishment, invasive impact, absence or non-detection claim is made.
